sources.summary:
A new online archive of Esther Mahlangu’s life and art is now on Google Arts & Culture.
This Google Arts & Culture retrospective honors Dr. Esther Mahlangu with 45 stories and AI-recreated memories of her Ndebele art. See the exhibition.
A new online archive of Esther Mahlangu’s life and art is now on Google Arts & Culture.
Nov 11, 2026
Discover Google Arts & Culture's online retrospective of the South African artist, which features more than 45 curated stories, virtual tours, and her early memo
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Arts & Culture上线Dr. Esther Mahlangu首个在线回顾展，献礼其91岁生日，汇集45个以上故事与档案，并用AI重现她1980年前缺失的童年记忆，向全球观众呈现Ndebele艺术。

en.reason: Google Arts & Culture has launched the first online retrospective of Dr. Esther Mahlangu for her 91st birthday, gathering more than 45 stories and archives and using AI to recreate her missing pre-1980 childhood memories of Ndebele art.

sources.title_en: Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 2026年12月8日起，GitHub 将暂停过去一年无活动仓库的 Dependabot alerts，现有告警归档不删除，任意 push 可自动恢复并重置一年计时。

en.reason: From December 8, 2026, GitHub will pause Dependabot alerts on most repositories with no activity in the past year, archiving rather than deleting existing alerts, with any push restoring them and resetting the one-year timer.
